prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Pearland, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1394; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you reported in Pearland, Texas. Can you state your full name for the record?

A: Yes, I'd rather keep my name off the recording, if that's all right. You can use the claim file for that.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe what you were doing when the collision happened?

A: I was driving through an intersection and wanted to turn left. The light was green, but I was waiting for a gap in oncoming traffic before I went.

Q: How did the other vehicle come into the picture?

A: A car coming the other way hit the front of my vehicle while I was turning. It came in pretty fast, from what I could see.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Did airbags deploy in your vehicle?

A: No, they didn't. The impact jolted me forward and then back against the seat.

Q: Have you sought medical attention since the collision?

A: I went to an urgent care clinic the same day. They said I have whiplash. My neck is stiff and I get headaches when I turn my head quickly.

Q: Are you currently under a doctor's care for those symptoms?

A: Yes, I have a follow-up scheduled, and I'm doing some physical therapy exercises at home.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add about the collision?

A: Only that I've been careful to follow the treatment plan. I want the claim handled properly so I can get back to normal.

Q: Thank you. That concludes this statement.
